title: Jacob Elordi Reveals Why Ridley Scott Is Every Actor’s Dream Collaborator
content:
Jacob Elordi got candid about working with Ridley Scott. The Frankenstein star will soon appear in the upcoming sci-fi project The Dog Stars. Ahead of the movie’s theatrical release this week, Elordi praised the acclaimed veteran filmmaker. “I’d argue that he’s on everyone’s list of cinematic heroes,” said Elordi in a new featurette for The […]
